rows.text: The party's page on the extraordinary party convention captions its opening at 13:01 on ９月２２日 (臨時党大会開会).
The same page captions the election administration committee chair 谷川 reporting the result of the presidential election to the convention at 13:10 (総裁選挙の結果を報告する谷川選挙管理委員長).
The same page captions 小渕総裁 shaking hands with 加藤 and 山崎 at 13:15 and 小渕総裁による挨拶 (the greeting by 小渕総裁) at 13:18 on ９月２２日.
